2608.02660.title: AI Alignment and Fiduciary Obligation
2608.02660.paper_summary: Advanced AI assistants engage users in extended interactions across a widening range of roles, including advice, decision support, collaboration, learning, emotional support, and companionship among others. Current alignment efforts consider what alignment criteria should govern these relationships, drawing on moral traditions developed for human relationships such as bioethics, virtue ethics, care ethics, and relationship science. This paper considers AI alignment criteria in the user-AI-developer triad, since every user-AI interaction is mediated by a developer who exercises discretionary control over a system's behaviour, memory, and engagement parameters. Drawing on business ethics and legal scholarship, I argue that fiduciary theory applies to extended AI assistant deployment. On this basis, the four canonical fiduciary duties of loyalty, care, good faith, and candour can generate alignment criteria for the developer-user relationship. I map four user-side risks of extended AI assistant deployment to the four duties and specify institutional measures that follow from discharging each duty. The discussion complements existing approaches by grounding alignment criteria in obligations the developer owes the user, rather than in values the user-AI interaction should promote, and by showing that those obligations hold independently of any \textit{de facto} harm to users.
2608.02660.paper_summary_zh: 進階的 AI 助手在越來越多的角色中與用戶進行延長互動，包括建議、決策支持、協作、學習、情感支持和陪伴等。當前的對齊努力考慮了應該如何管理這些關係的對齊標準，借鑒了為人際關係發展的道德傳統，如生物倫理學、美德倫理學、關懷倫理學和關係科學。本文考慮了用戶-AI-開發者三方中的 AI 對齊標準，因為每次用戶-AI 互動都是由一位開發者調解的，該開發者對系統的行為、記憶和參與參數行使自由控制。基於商業倫理和法律學術，我主張受託理論適用於延長的 AI 助手部署。在此基礎上，忠誠、關懷、善意和坦誠這四項經典的受託義務可以為開發者-用戶關係生成對齊標準。我將延長 AI 助手部署的四個用戶風險映射到四項義務上，並具體說明履行每項義務所需的制度措施。這一討論通過將對齊標準建立在開發者對用戶的義務上，而不是用戶-AI 互動應該促進的價值上，來補充現有的方法，並顯示這些義務獨立於對用戶的任何 \textit{de facto} 傷害。
2608.02660.author: Benjamin Lange et.al.
